authorInfo.bio: Anthony Trollope (1815–1882) is the author of The Warden. This historical edition is part of the author’s surviving literary work. Explore the linked biographical record for their life and bibliography.

description: "An Eye for an Eye" by Anthony Trollope is a novel written in 1870 and published in 1878-1879. Fred Neville, a cavalry lieutenant and heir to an earldom, seduces Kate O'Hara in Ireland, making promises he cannot keep.
